Audio

Race data

Each recorded race is also sent to the game's developer to help balance ships, modules and tracks. No names: other pilots in a room go as Pilot 1, Pilot 2 and so on. Switch it off any time.

Music is synthesised live, with drum hits and effects from the Sonic Pi sample pack (freesound.org recordings, public domain under CC0). The announcer and sung chops use the open Kokoro speech model (Apache-2.0). Sound effects are public-domain (CC0) recordings from Kenney (kenney.nl), rubberduck on OpenGameArt.org and the Sonic Pi pack.

LEADERBOARD

STYLE
Pick a look, then switch any part on or off · the cube exhaust is always on · try them in a race from the pause menu
Lower resolution is the biggest saving on a slow phone or tablet: 50% draws a quarter of the pixels, 25% (Ultra low) a sixteenth, and it goes down to 10%. Low detail drops the ship shadows, thins the scenery and leaves out the falls and geysers (from the next track). Lite audio, in Music, saves a little more. Every look races the same, so times count on the boards whichever you pick.
